subject: Closing runway & dataset handback playbook for NovaRetail pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@novaretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot close timeline & exchange of test assets

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the canary plan. We're approaching our internal steering committee next Wednesday and need a concrete mutual action plan for exchanging the evaluation material (testcases + a sample prompt pack) and a tight close/runway for the pilot.

Quick asks from our side:
- A one-page MAP with milestones and owner assignments (we need it by EOD Tuesday so we can send to procurement)
- A short list of usage constraints (token retention, ephemeral storage, allowed compute) so our security folks can sign off
- Confirmation of how and when assets will be destroyed after the pilot

We can send the assets under our NDA, but want to avoid a long procurement loop. Can you propose the schedule and a checklist for the handback?

Attachments: staging-checklist-template.xlsx (we'll share the dataset after we align)

Best,
Alyssa Park
Head of ML Ops, NovaRetail
Alyssa Park | +1 415-555-0199

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@novaretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot close timeline & exchange of test assets

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a draft MAP and a sample prompt pack we typically use for pilots. High level proposal below, open to tightening the windows if you need faster signoff.

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Day 0 (agreement signed): Redwood provides secure S3 access to a sandbox bucket + promptpack sample (promptpack-sample-v1.zip)
- Day 3: NovaRetail ingests and runs smoke tests; submit acceptance checklist to ben@redwood.com
- Day 7: Two-week acceptance window begins (functional acceptance + quality checks)
- Day 21 (or earlier): Asset handback / destruction window — Redwood provides a destruction confirmation and audit log

Usage constraints (short list for your security):
- Assets are accessed only from our private sandbox; no downstream copying outside the bucket
- KV/prefix caching retained only for the duration of the pilot, then purged; token-level logs retained for 14 days for debugging and then deleted
- No export of raw testcases; evaluation outputs (model responses) can be retained by NovaRetail for internal analysis only

I've attached: "20260921-Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf" and the promptpack. Ben will follow up with the acceptance checklist link and Markus will add a quick note on how we audit the destruction step.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20260921-Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf; promptpack-sample-v1.zip

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@novaretail.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot close timeline & exchange of test assets

Alyssa — adding the operational checklist here and the intake form link. A few clarifications:
- Access: We'll create a short-lived IAM role scoped to the sandbox bucket (valid for the pilot duration + 2d buffer)
- Audit: We'll produce a destruction report (signed S3 lifecycle + manual deletion confirmation) with SHA256 of artifacts removed
- Acceptance criteria: pass < 5% regression on your evaluation prompts OR agreed manual sign-off

Intake & acceptance form: https://forms.redwood.com/NR-049/pilot-intake

On the destruction cadence: Markus, can you confirm the timeline for generating the deletion audit (S3 logs + manual attestation)?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood
Attachment: promptpack-acceptance-checklist.docx

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Alyssa Park <alyssa@novaretail.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot close timeline & exchange of test assets

Hi all — short technical note on destruction & audit:
- We will run a lifecycle delete in the sandbox bucket on Day 21 and then trigger our manual verify-and-record flow. Verification steps:
  1) Confirm object list and compute SHA256 for each artifact
  2) Execute s3:DeleteObjects
  3) Capture S3 server access logs for the delete events (we archive for 30 days)
  4) Produce a PDF attestation with the object list, SHAs, timestamp, and the operator's signature

The attestation and S3 logs will be delivered to legal@novaretail.com and to your Redwood account team. If you need shorter log retention we can redact or compress — let us know.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@novaretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: NovaRetail Legal <legal@novaretail.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot close timeline & exchange of test assets

Grace / Ben / Markus — this looks good and is exactly the level of detail the committee wanted. A few final items:
- Legal will need the MAP + destruction attestation template attached to our procurement packet (I've CC'd legal).
- We will countersign the NDA and transmit the dataset to the S3 sandbox once we get your IAM role + intake form filled (target: Tue EOD)
- Please add a one-line fallback: if Redwood cannot complete destruction attestation by Day 22, NovaRetail may request an emergency remote wipe (we'll coordinate scope)

We can move forward on the proposed timeline. I'll have Legal confirm the countersigned NDA and the procurement intake by tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth pilot.
Alyssa
Head of ML Ops, NovaRetail
Attachment: NovaRetail-NDA-signed.pdf
